verses.ar: صٓ وَالۡقُرۡاٰنِ ذِي الذِّكۡرِؕ‏
verses.en: Sād . I swear by the Qur’ān, (the book) containing advice, (this is true,)

verses.ar: بَلِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فِيۡ عِزَّةٍ وَّشِقَاقٍ
verses.en: but those who disbelieve are (involved) in false pride and opposition.

verses.ar: كَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡنٍ فَنَادَوۡا وَّلَاتَ حِيۡنَ مَنَاصٍ
verses.en: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, so they cried out (for mercy), while no time was left for having any refuge.

verses.ar: وَعَجِبُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مُّنۡذِرٌ مِّنۡهُمۡؗ وَقَالَ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ هٰذَا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌۚۖ‏
verses.en: They (the pagans) wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a sheer liar.

verses.ar: اَجَعَلَ الۡاٰلِهَةَ اِلٰهًا وَّاحِدًاۚۖ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابٌ
verses.en: Has he (not) turned all the gods into a single God? It is a very strange thing indeed.”

verses.ar: وَانۡطَلَقَ الۡمَلَاُ مِنۡهُمۡ اَنِ امۡشُوۡا وَاصۡبِرُوۡا عَلٰ٘ي اٰلِهَتِكُمۡۚۖ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ يُّرَادُۚ‏
verses.en: And the leaders among them walked out saying (to their followers), “Walk away (from the Prophet,) and stay firm on (adhering to) your gods. This (call of the Prophet) is surely something designed (for his personal benefit).

verses.ar: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهٰذَا فِي الۡمِلَّةِ الۡاٰخِرَةِۚۖ اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا اخۡتِلَاقٌۚۖ‏
verses.en: We never heard of it in the classical faith (of ours). This is nothing but a false invention.

verses.ar: ءَاُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ الذِّكۡرُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِنَاؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡ ذِكۡرِيۡۚ بَلۡ لَّمَّا يَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابِؕ‏
verses.en: Is it (believable) that the message of advice has been sent down to him (alone) from among all of us?” The fact is that they are in doubt about My message; rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

verses.ar: اَمۡ عِنۡدَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡوَهَّابِۚ‏
verses.en: Do they have the treasures of the mercy of your Lord, the Mighty, the Bountiful?

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ مُّلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاࣞ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُوۡا فِي الۡاَسۡبَابِ
verses.en: Or do they have the ownership of the heavens and the earth and what lies between them? Then let them ascend (to the sky) by ropes.

verses.ar: جُنۡدٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُوۡمٌ مِّنَ الۡاَحۡزَابِ
verses.en: What is there (in Makkah) is just a host of the (opposing) groups that has to be defeated.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوۡحٍ وَّعَادٌ وَّفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو الۡاَوۡتَادِۙ‏
verses.en: Even before them, the people of NūH and ‘Ād and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), the man of stakes,

verses.ar: وَثَمُوۡدُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوۡطٍ وَّاَصۡحٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ الۡاَحۡزَابُ
verses.en: and Thamūd and the people of LūT and the people of Aaikah have rejected (the messengers). They were the (strong) groups.

verses.ar: اِنۡ كُلٌّ اِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِࣖ‏
verses.en: All of them did nothing but declare the messengers as liars; hence, My punishment became due.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَنۡظُرُ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِنۡ فَوَاقٍ
verses.en: And these people are waiting for nothing but for a single Cry (the sound of the Trumpet to be blown on Doomsday) that will have no pause.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا عَجِّلۡ لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ الۡحِسَابِ
verses.en: And they say, “O our Lord, give us our share (of the punishment) sooner, before the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.ar: اِصۡبِرۡ عَلٰي مَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ وَاذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوٗدَ ذَا الۡاَيۡدِۚ اِنَّهٗ٘ اَوَّابٌ
verses.en: Bear patiently with what they say, and remember Our servant Dawūd, the man of might. Surely he was ever-turning to Allah.

verses.ar: اِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا الۡجِبَالَ مَعَهٗ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِالۡعَشِيِّ وَالۡاِشۡرَاقِۙ‏
verses.en: We had subjugated the mountains to join him (in) making tasbīH (i.e. pronouncing Allah’s purity) at evening and sunrise,

verses.ar: وَالطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُوۡرَةًؕ كُلٌّ لَّهٗ٘ اَوَّابٌ
verses.en: and the birds as well, mustered together. All were turning to Allah with him.

verses.ar: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهٗ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ الۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ الۡخِطَابِ
verses.en: And We made his kingdom strong, and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.

verses.ar: وَهَلۡ اَتٰىكَ نَبَؤُا الۡخَصۡمِۘ اِذۡ تَسَوَّرُوا الۡمِحۡرَابَۙ‏
verses.en: Has there come to you the story of the litigants, when they entered the sanctuary by climbing over the wall?

verses.ar: اِذۡ دَخَلُوۡا عَلٰي دَاوٗدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡ قَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡۚ خَصۡمٰنِ بَغٰي بَعۡضُنَا عَلٰي بَعۡضٍ فَاحۡكُمۡ بَيۡنَنَا بِالۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَاهۡدِنَا٘ اِلٰي سَوَآءِ الصِّرَاطِ
verses.en: When they entered upon Dawūd, and he was scared of them, they said, “Be not scared. We are two litigants; one of us has wronged the other, so decide between us with truth, and do not cross the limits, and guide us to the right path.

verses.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا٘ اَخِيۡࣞ لَهٗ تِسۡعٌ وَّتِسۡعُوۡنَ نَعۡجَةً وَّلِيَ نَعۡجَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌࣞ فَقَالَ اَكۡفِلۡنِيۡهَا وَعَزَّنِيۡ فِي الۡخِطَابِ
verses.en: This is my brother; he has ninety nine ewes, and I have a single ewe; still he said, ‘Give it into my charge.’ And he overpowered me in speech.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ اِلٰي نِعَاجِهٖؕ وَاِنَّ كَثِيۡرًا مِّنَ الۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِيۡ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلٰي بَعۡضٍ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَقَلِيۡلٌ مَّا هُمۡؕ وَظَنَّ دَاوٗدُ اَنَّمَا فَتَنّٰهُ فَاسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهٗ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَّاَنَابَࣛ‏
verses.en: He (Dawūd) said, “He has certainly wronged you by demanding your ewe to be added to his ewe. Many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous deeds, and very few they are.” And Dawūd realized that We had put him to a test, so he prayed to his Lord for forgiveness, and bowing down, he fell in prostration, and turned (to Allah).

verses.ar: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهٗ ذٰلِكَؕ وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنۡدَنَا لَزُلۡفٰي وَحُسۡنَ مَاٰبٍ
verses.en: So we forgave him that (lapse), and surely he has a place of nearness in Our presence, and an excellent resort.

verses.ar: يٰدَاوٗدُ اِنَّا جَعَلۡنٰكَ خَلِيۡفَةً فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَاحۡكُمۡ بَيۡنَ النَّاسِ بِالۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الۡهَوٰي فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَضِلُّوۡنَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ شَدِيۡدٌۭ بِمَا نَسُوۡا يَوۡمَ الۡحِسَابِࣖ‏
verses.en: O Dawūd, We have made you a vicegerent on earth, so judge between people with truth, and do not follow the selfish desire, lest it should lead you astray from Allah’s path. Surely those who go astray from Allah’s path will have a severe punishment, because they had forgotten the Day of Reckoning.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمَآءَ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَاطِلًاؕ ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡاۚ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنَ النَّارِؕ‏
verses.en: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them in vain. That is the thinking of those who disbelieve. So, woe to the disbelievers because of the Fire (they have to face).

verses.ar: اَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَالۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؗ اَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ كَالۡفُجَّارِ
verses.en: Shall We make those who believe and do righteous deeds equal to those who commit mischief on the earth? Or shall We make the God-fearing equal to the sinners?

verses.ar: كِتٰبٌ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ اِلَيۡكَ مُبٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوۡ٘ا اٰيٰتِهٖ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ اُولُوا الۡاَلۡبَابِ
verses.en: This is a blessed Book We have revealed to you, so that they deliberate in its verses, and so that the men of understanding may heed to advice.

verses.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوٗدَ سُلَيۡمٰنَؕ نِعۡمَ الۡعَبۡدُؕ اِنَّهٗ٘ اَوَّابٌؕ‏
verses.en: And We blessed Dawūd with Sulaimān. He was an excellent servant (of Allah). Surely, he was great in turning (to Us, in penitence and praise).

verses.ar: اِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِالۡعَشِيِّ الصّٰفِنٰتُ الۡجِيَادُۙ‏
verses.en: (Worth remembering is the incident) when the swift horses of high breeding were presented before him in the evening.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ الۡخَيۡرِ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ رَبِّيۡۚ حَتّٰي تَوَارَتۡ بِالۡحِجَابِࣞ‏
verses.en: He said, “I held the love of the good things (i.e. these horses) because of the remembrance of my Lord.” until it went behind the veil.

verses.ar: رُدُّوۡهَا عَلَيَّؕ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحًاۭ بِالسُّوۡقِ وَالۡاَعۡنَاقِ
verses.en: (Then he said,) “Bring them back to me” - and he started passing his hands over the shanks and the necks (of the horses).

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمٰنَ وَاَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلٰي كُرۡسِيِّهٖ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ اَنَابَ
verses.en: And indeed We tested Sulaimān while We threw on his throne a body after which he turned (to Us).

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِيۡ وَهَبۡ لِيۡ مُلۡكًا لَّا يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لِاَحَدٍ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِيۡۚ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡوَهَّابُ
verses.en: He said, “O my Lord, forgive me, and bless me with a kingdom that will not be available to anyone after me. Surely, You are the Bountiful.”

verses.ar: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ الرِّيۡحَ تَجۡرِيۡ بِاَمۡرِهٖ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ اَصَابَۙ‏
verses.en: Then We subjugated the wind for him that blew smoothly on his command to wherever he wished,

verses.ar: وَالشَّيٰطِيۡنَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَّغَوَّاصٍۙ‏
verses.en: and (We subjugated to him) the devils (among Jinns), all builders and divers,

verses.ar: وَّاٰخَرِيۡنَ مُقَرَّنِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَصۡفَادِ
verses.en: and many others held in chains.

verses.ar: هٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَامۡنُنۡ اَوۡ اَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.en: This is Our gift. So, do favor (to someone) or withhold (it), with no (requirement to give) account.

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنۡدَنَا لَزُلۡفٰي وَحُسۡنَ مَاٰبٍࣖ‏
verses.en: He has a place of nearness in Our presence, and an excellent end.

verses.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا٘ اَيُّوۡبَۘ اِذۡ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗ٘ اَنِّيۡ مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيۡطٰنُ بِنُصۡبٍ وَّعَذَابٍؕ‏
verses.en: And remember Our servant, Ayyūb - when he called his Lord saying, “The ShaiTān (Satan) has inflicted weariness and pain upon me.”

verses.ar: اُرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۚ هٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلٌۭ بَارِدٌ وَّشَرَابٌ
verses.en: (Allah said to him,) “Strike (the ground) with your foot: Here is a cool water to bathe, and a drink!”

verses.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ٘ اَهۡلَهٗ وَمِثۡلَهُمۡ مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرٰي لِاُولِي الۡاَلۡبَابِ
verses.en: And We let him have his family and the like of them besides, as a mercy from Us, and a reminder for the people of understanding.

verses.ar: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثًا فَاضۡرِبۡ بِّهٖ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡؕ اِنَّا وَجَدۡنٰهُ صَابِرًاؕ نِعۡمَ الۡعَبۡدُؕ اِنَّهٗ٘ اَوَّابٌ
verses.en: And (We said to him,) “Take (a bundle of) thin twigs in your hand, and strike with it, and do not violate your oath. Surely, We found him very enduring. He was really an excellent servant. Surely, he was great in turning (to Us, in penitence and praise).

verses.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ عِبٰدَنَا٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ اُولِي الۡاَيۡدِيۡ وَالۡاَبۡصَارِ
verses.en: And remember Our servants - Ibrāhīm and IsHāq and Ya‘qūb - the men of strength and the men of vision.

verses.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَخۡلَصۡنٰهُمۡ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكۡرَي الدَّارِۚ‏
verses.en: We chose them for a trait of remembering the (eternal) Home (in the Hereafter).

verses.ar: وَاِنَّهُمۡ عِنۡدَنَا لَمِنَ الۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ الۡاَخۡيَارِؕ‏
verses.en: And surely they are, in Our sight, among the chosen, the best of the righteous.

verses.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ اِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَالۡيَسَعَ وَذَا الۡكِفۡلِؕ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الۡاَخۡيَارِؕ‏
verses.en: And remember Ismā‘īl and Al-Yasa‘ and Dhul-Kifl. Each one of them was among the best of the righteous.

verses.ar: هٰذَا ذِكۡرٌؕ وَاِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ لَحُسۡنَ مَاٰبٍۙ‏
verses.en: This is a reminder (of what has passed). And surely the God-fearing will have the best place to return:

verses.ar: جَنّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ الۡاَبۡوَابُۚ‏
verses.en: - everlasting gardens, with (their) doors opened for them.

verses.ar: مُتَّكِـِٕيۡنَ فِيۡهَا يَدۡعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيۡرَةٍ وَّشَرَابٍ
verses.en: They will be relaxing in it, calling there for plenteous fruits and drinks;

verses.ar: وَعِنۡدَهُمۡ قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرۡفِ اَتۡرَابٌ
verses.en: and in their company there will be females restricting their glances (to their husbands, and) of matching ages.

verses.ar: هٰذَا مَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ لِيَوۡمِ الۡحِسَابِࣚ‏
verses.en: This is what you are being promised for the Day of Reckoning.

verses.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهٗ مِنۡ نَّفَادٍۚۖ‏
verses.en: Surely, that is provision provided by Us, to which there is no end.

verses.ar: هٰذَاؕ وَاِنَّ لِلطّٰغِيۡنَ لَشَرَّ مَاٰبٍۙ‏
verses.en: Having said this, the transgressors will surely have the most evil place to return:

verses.ar: جَهَنَّمَۚ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَاۚ فَبِئۡسَ الۡمِهَادُ
verses.en: the Jahannam , in which they will enter. So, how evil is that place to rest?

verses.ar: هٰذَاۙ فَلۡيَذُوۡقُوۡهُ حَمِيۡمٌ وَّغَسَّاقٌۙ‏
verses.en: Let them taste this: hot water and pus,

verses.ar: وَّاٰخَرُ مِنۡ شَكۡلِهٖ٘ اَزۡوَاجٌؕ‏
verses.en: and other things similar to it of various kinds.

verses.ar: هٰذَا فَوۡجٌ مُّقۡتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمۡۚ لَا مَرۡحَبًاۭ بِهِمۡؕ اِنَّهُمۡ صَالُوا النَّارِ
verses.en: (When the leaders of the infidels will see their followers entering the Hell after them, they will say to each other,) “This is a multitude rushing into (the Hell) with you - they are not welcome - they are to burn in the Fire.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡࣞ لَا مَرۡحَبًاۭ بِكُمۡؕ اَنۡتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوۡهُ لَنَاۚ فَبِئۡسَ الۡقَرَارُ
verses.en: They (the followers) will say (to their leaders) “No, it is you who are not welcome; you are the ones who brought this upon us.” So, how evil is the place to stay (for ever)!”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا مَنۡ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابًا ضِعۡفًا فِي النَّارِ
verses.en: They (the followers) will say, “Our Lord, whoever has brought this on us, do increase his punishment twofold in the Fire.”

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرٰي رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَشۡرَارِؕ‏
verses.en: And they (the infidels) will say, “What is the matter with us that we do not see those men (here in Hell) whom we used to count amongst the worst? (i.e the Muslims whom the infidels used to treat as the worst people among them)

verses.ar: اَتَّخَذۡنٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا اَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ الۡاَبۡصَارُ
verses.en: Had we taken them as a laughing-stock (unjustly), or have our eyes missed them?”

verses.ar: اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ اَهۡلِ النَّارِࣖ‏
verses.en: That is going to happen definitely, that is, the mutual quarrel of the people of the Fire.

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا مُنۡذِرٌࣗۖ وَّمَا مِنۡ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ الۡوَاحِدُ الۡقَهَّارُۚ‏
verses.en: Say, “I am only a warner, and there is no god but Allah, the One, the All-Dominant,

verses.ar: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡغَفَّارُ
verses.en: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the Mighty, the Very-Forgiving.”

verses.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا عَظِيۡمٌۙ‏
verses.en: Say, “It is a great news

verses.ar: اَنۡتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُوۡنَ
verses.en: to which you are averse.

verses.ar: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۭ بِالۡمَلَاِ الۡاَعۡلٰ٘ي اِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: I had no knowledge of the Heavenly Beings when they were debating (about the creation of ’Ādam).

verses.ar: اِنۡ يُّوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيَّ اِلَّا٘ اَنَّمَا٘ اَنَا نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: Revelation is sent to me only because I am a plain warner.

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اِنِّيۡ خَالِقٌۭ بَشَرًا مِّنۡ طِيۡنٍ
verses.en: When your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create man from clay.

verses.ar: فَاِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهٗ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رُّوۡحِيۡ فَقَعُوۡا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: So, once I make him perfectly and breath My spirit into him, you must fall down in prostration before him.”

verses.ar: فَسَجَدَ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Then, the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together -

verses.ar: اِلَّا٘ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ اِسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: except Iblīs (Satan). He waxed proud, and became one of the disbelievers.

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰ٘اِبۡلِيۡسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اَنۡ تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّؕ اَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ اَمۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الۡعَالِيۡنَ
verses.en: He (Allah) said, “O Iblīs, what did prevent you from prostrating yourself before what I created with My hands? Did you wax proud or were you among the lofty ones?”

verses.ar: قَالَ اَنَا خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡهُؕ خَلَقۡتَنِيۡ مِنۡ نَّارٍ وَّخَلَقۡتَهٗ مِنۡ طِيۡنٍ
verses.en: He said, “I am better than him. You created me from fire, and created him from clay.”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيۡمٌۖۙ‏
verses.en: He said, “Then, get out from here, for you are accursed,

verses.ar: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيۡ٘ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الدِّيۡنِ
verses.en: and on you shall remain My curse till the Day of Judgment.”

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنۡظِرۡنِيۡ٘ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “O my Lord, then give me respite till the day they are raised again.”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الۡمُنۡظَرِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: He said, “Then, you have been given respite,

verses.ar: اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡوَقۡتِ الۡمَعۡلُوۡمِ
verses.en: until the Day of the Appointed Time.”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَاُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: He said, “Then, I swear by Your Might, that I will definitely lead them astray, all of them -

verses.ar: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ الۡمُخۡلَصِيۡنَ
verses.en: except Your chosen servants among them.”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَالۡحَقُّؗ وَالۡحَقَّ اَقُوۡلُۚ‏
verses.en: He (Allah) said, “Then, the truth is-and it is (always) the truth that I speak-

verses.ar: لَاَمۡلَـَٔنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنۡكَ وَمِمَّنۡ تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ
verses.en: that I will definitely fill the Jahannam with you and with those who will follow you from among them, all together.”

verses.ar: قُلۡ مَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ وَّمَا٘ اَنَا مِنَ الۡمُتَكَلِّفِيۡنَ
verses.en: Say (O Prophet to the unbelievers,) “I do not demand from you any fee for it, nor am I from among those who make up things artificially.

verses.ar: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكۡرٌ لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: It is nothing but an advice for all the worlds.

verses.ar: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَاَهٗ بَعۡدَ حِيۡنٍࣖ‏
verses.en: And you will come to know its reality after a while.”
